review_scope: Seven proposal sections, mainline, numerical and methodological claims, bounded application scope and relative schedule; no layout review.

checks.detail: Original title retained; recovery-supervision method is the main research thread; radar is one bounded application chapter.
Six chapters align method construction, public controlled evaluation, same-state analysis, radar application and conclusion; standalone radar construction chapter removed.
Dependency-consistent recovery supervision is the main method; paired evaluation is research design/evidence; radar is application value, not a second algorithm claim.
Retains common successful prefix and first reference-divergent action/observation; maps reference dependencies; makes no semantic-error-label claim for the divergence or empty results.
States shared initial model, successful material, logical suffix, question order and supervised-token budget; avoids asserting equal compute.
2000 project-held-out questions; two shared-initialization continuation seeds; 78.75% to 83.50%, +4.75pp, question-paired CI [3.53,5.98]; ordinary/recovery arms each 788534 supervised tokens.
8.84% and 4.17% reductions explicitly refer to input-plus-generated totals for the two continuation seeds relative to ordinary stepwise controls.
2400 is a candidate pool; matched N/D states and continuation budgets; divergent C-A is primary, normal contrast and difference-in-differences secondary; new evaluation remains planned.
418 historical admitted pairs, 414 exactly comparable, 4 environment-detail mismatches; direct65 and mapped414 all-call-executable counts correctly represent offline target construction.
576 training questions used to train I_domain; 108 development questions used for query-capability diagnosis; fixed24+12 evaluated separately.
Reuses frozen domain materials and interfaces; a paired reproduction is conditional on worthwhile development signal; application conclusion follows measurements, not promised gain.
Historical73/80,17/11 and55/68 are attributed to flat/condition-bound evidence representation, not recovery training transfer.
Completed source reviews are identified as AI; future human spot review remains distinct and no human-completion claim is made.

Six-month plan is the existing relative stage plan without resetting submission deadline; environment/model verification precedes inference; old predictions and same-state preflight are distinguished.
OEC formal ICML2026 citation and ReTerm v2 metadata agree with locally verified short-paper references; no new web verification claimed in this review.
Results-oriented wording; scope conveyed through task/experiment definitions rather than repeated defensive prose; no unsupported guarantee of domain gain or graduation acceptance.
